summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K by blank-check company Valuence Merger Corp. I disclosing a one-month extension of its deadline to complete an initial business combination, from August 3, 2026 to September 3, 2026. The board approved the extension, the fourth of ten potential monthly extensions available, and deposited $13,897.14 into the trust account. This is an administrative SPAC extension notice, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premiums, or transactions are involved; the registrant is simply maintaining its timeline to find a target.
